older
blanks.tr: 'noticeably more cooler' → doğru sözcük 'cooler'; önlemlerin amacı şehri serinletmek. 'hotter' amacı tersine çevirir.
blanks.en: 'noticeably cooler' fits: the measures aim to cool cities. 'hotter' reverses the aim.

restate.stem: Although the report acknowledges that climate change will displace millions of people, it stops short of recommending any binding international agreement.
opts: While the report admits that climate change will drive mass displacement, it does not go so far as to call for a binding international treaty.
The report denies that climate change will force anyone to move and therefore sees no need for an agreement.
The report calls for a binding international agreement precisely because climate change will displace millions.
The report argues that an international agreement would be useless against the displacement caused by climate change.
restate.tr: 'acknowledges ... but stops short of recommending' = kabul eder ama önermeye varmaz; doğru cevap hem iklim kaynaklı göçün kabulünü hem de bağlayıcı anlaşma önerilmemesi çekincesini korur. Çeldiriciler ya kabulü inkâr eder ya da anlaşmayı savunarak anlamı tersine çevirir.
restate.en: 'acknowledges ... but stops short of recommending' keeps both the admission of displacement and the refusal to call for a binding treaty; the distractors either deny the admission or reverse it.

restate.stem: The improvement reported by some patients may owe less to the drug itself than to their expectation that it will work.
opts: The drug is clearly responsible for the improvement that patients report.
The reported improvement might stem more from patients' expectations than from the medicine.
Patients improve only when they have no expectations about the drug.
Patients' expectations have no measurable effect on whether they improve.
restate.tr: 'may owe less to X than to Y' = X'ten çok Y'ye bağlı olabilir; doğru cevap iyileşmenin ilaçtan çok beklentiye bağlı olabileceği karşılaştırmasını korur. Çeldiriciler ilacı tek sorumlu sayar ya da beklentiyi yok sayar.
restate.en: 'may owe less to X than to Y' means it is more due to Y (expectation); the correct option keeps that comparison, while distractors credit the drug or dismiss expectation.

restate.stem: Analysis of the bones suggests that the community relied heavily on fish, rather than on farmed grain as scholars had previously assumed.
opts: The bones confirm the old view that the community lived mainly on farmed grain.
The community ate neither fish nor grain, according to the bones.
The bones show that the community ate mostly fish, contrary to the earlier belief that grain was their main food.
Scholars still believe that grain was more important than fish for this community.
restate.tr: 'relied heavily on fish, rather than grain as scholars had assumed' = balığa dayandı, sanılan tahıla değil; doğru cevap bu karşıtlığı korur. Çeldiriciler eski tahıl görüşünü doğrular ya da her ikisini de reddeder.
restate.en: 'relied on fish, rather than grain as scholars had assumed' contrasts the new finding with the old assumption; the correct option keeps it, while distractors reaffirm the grain view or deny both.

restate.stem: Automation is likely to eliminate many routine jobs, but it may also create new roles that we cannot yet imagine.
opts: Automation will destroy jobs without producing any new ones.
Automation will create new jobs only by preserving the routine ones.
The new roles created by automation are already clearly understood.
Although automation will probably remove many routine jobs, it could also generate new kinds of work that are hard to foresee.
restate.tr: 'likely to eliminate ... but may also create' = hem yok edebilir hem yaratabilir; doğru cevap her iki yönü de korur. Çeldiriciler yaratımı yok sayar ya da yeni rollerin şimdiden bilindiğini iddia ederek 'cannot yet imagine' ile çelişir.
restate.en: 'likely to eliminate ... but may also create' keeps both sides; the correct option preserves them, while distractors drop the job creation or contradict 'cannot yet imagine'.

restate.stem: Scientists cannot predict the exact day a volcano will erupt, but they can often tell when an eruption is becoming more likely.
opts: Though scientists cannot fix the exact date of an eruption, they can frequently detect when one is growing more probable.
Scientists can name the precise day of an eruption well in advance.
Scientists know nothing about when a volcano might erupt.
Volcanic eruptions happen without any warning signs at all.
restate.tr: 'cannot predict the exact day but can tell when more likely' = kesin günü değil ama olasılık artışını söyleyebilir; doğru cevap bu ayrımı korur. Çeldiriciler ya kesin tarih verir ya da hiçbir şey bilinemez diyerek uç noktalara kaçar.
restate.en: 'cannot predict the exact day but can tell when more likely' is preserved; the distractors swing to extremes (exact date vs. no knowledge).

restate.stem: The survey found that people who read regularly as children are more likely to enjoy books as adults.
opts: Childhood reading has no connection with whether adults enjoy books.
According to the survey, regular reading in childhood is linked to a greater enjoyment of books later in life.
Adults who dislike books were always frequent readers in childhood.
The survey proves that reading in childhood guarantees a love of books forever.
restate.tr: 'more likely to enjoy' = olasılık bildirir; doğru cevap çocukluk okumasıyla yetişkin keyfi arasındaki ihtimalli bağı korur. 'guarantees' diyen çeldirici kesinliğe kaçarak abartır; diğeri bağı koparır.
restate.en: 'more likely to enjoy' is probabilistic; the correct option keeps the link, while a distractor overstates it with 'guarantees' and another severs the link.

restate.stem: Rapid economic growth raised average incomes, yet it did little to narrow the gap between the richest and the poorest.
opts: Economic growth both raised incomes and sharply reduced inequality.
Economic growth lowered average incomes while widening inequality.
Although growth lifted average incomes, it had hardly any effect on the divide between rich and poor.
Growth closed the gap between rich and poor without changing average incomes.
restate.tr: 'raised incomes, yet did little to narrow the gap' = gelir arttı ama uçurum daralmadı; doğru cevap bu karşıtlığı korur. Çeldiriciler eşitsizliğin azaldığını ya da gelirin düştüğünü söyleyerek çelişir.
restate.en: 'raised incomes, yet did little to narrow the gap' keeps both; distractors claim inequality fell or incomes dropped.

restate.stem: Speaking two languages from an early age does not delay a child's development, as was once feared, but appears to strengthen certain mental skills.
opts: Learning two languages early seriously slows down a child's development.
Bilingual children develop at exactly the same rate as others, with no advantages.
Children should avoid learning two languages until they are older.
Contrary to earlier fears, early bilingualism does not hold back development and may even enhance some cognitive abilities.
restate.tr: 'does not delay ... but appears to strengthen' = geciktirmez, hatta güçlendirir; doğru cevap iki noktayı da korur. Çeldiriciler eski 'gecikme' korkusunu doğrular ya da avantajı yok sayar.
restate.en: 'does not delay ... but appears to strengthen' keeps both; distractors revive the old fear of delay or ignore the advantage.

restate.stem: Without additional funding, the museum will be forced to reduce its opening hours and cancel several educational programmes.
opts: Unless it obtains more money, the museum will have to cut its hours and drop some of its educational programmes.
The museum will expand its programmes even if it receives no extra money.
The museum has already received the funding it needs to stay open.
Educational programmes are the only thing the museum plans to keep.
restate.tr: 'Without additional funding ... will be forced to reduce/cancel' = ek fon olmazsa kısmak/iptal zorunda; doğru cevap koşul-sonuç bağını korur. Çeldiriciler koşulu tersine çevirir (genişleme / fon zaten alındı).
restate.en: 'Without additional funding ... will be forced to reduce/cancel' keeps the condition-consequence; distractors reverse the condition (expansion / funding already secured).

restate.stem: The cost of solar power has fallen so dramatically that it is now cheaper than coal in many parts of the world.
opts: Solar power remains far more expensive than coal almost everywhere.
Solar power's price has dropped so sharply that, in many regions, it now undercuts coal.
Coal has become cheaper than solar power across most of the globe.
The price of solar power has hardly changed in recent years.
restate.tr: 'fallen so dramatically that it is now cheaper than coal' = öyle düştü ki kömürden ucuz; doğru cevap bu sonucu korur. Çeldiriciler fiyat ilişkisini tersine çevirir ya da düşüşü yok sayar.
restate.en: 'fallen so dramatically that it is now cheaper than coal' is kept; distractors reverse the price relation or deny the drop.

restate.stem: Long periods of stress can weaken the immune system, making people more vulnerable to common infections.
opts: Stress strengthens the immune system and protects people from infection.
Infections are the main cause of long-term stress in most people.
Prolonged stress can lower the body's defences, leaving people more open to ordinary infections.
Stress affects the immune system only over very short periods.
restate.tr: 'weaken the immune system, making more vulnerable' = bağışıklığı zayıflatıp savunmasız bırakır; doğru cevap aynı neden-sonucu korur. Çeldirici tam tersini (güçlendirir) iddia eder.
restate.en: 'weaken the immune system, making more vulnerable' keeps the cause-effect; a distractor claims the opposite (strengthens).

restate.stem: Far from being isolated, the early city maintained extensive contacts with distant regions through a network of trade routes.
opts: The early city was completely cut off from the rest of the world.
Trade routes existed but the city refused to use them.
The city traded only with its immediate neighbours.
Rather than standing alone, the early city was widely connected to far-off regions by trade routes.
restate.tr: 'Far from being isolated ... maintained extensive contacts' = izole olmak şöyle dursun, geniş temaslar; doğru cevap bu vurguyu korur. Çeldiriciler izolasyonu ya da yalnızca komşularla ticareti öne sürerek çelişir.
restate.en: 'Far from being isolated ... maintained extensive contacts' is kept; distractors suggest isolation or trade only with neighbours.

restate.stem: Regular physical activity not only improves fitness but also helps to reduce feelings of anxiety and low mood.
opts: Besides making people fitter, regular exercise can also ease anxiety and lift a low mood.
Exercise improves fitness but has no effect on a person's mood.
Exercise lifts the mood only in people who are already very fit.
Physical activity increases anxiety in most people who try it.
restate.tr: 'not only improves fitness but also reduces anxiety' = hem formu artırır hem kaygıyı azaltır; doğru cevap iki yararı da korur. Çeldiriciler ruh hali etkisini yok sayar ya da yönü tersine çevirir.
restate.en: 'not only improves fitness but also reduces anxiety' keeps both benefits; distractors drop the mood effect or reverse it.

restate.stem: When a language disappears, it is not only words that are lost but also a unique way of understanding the world.
opts: The loss of a language means losing only a list of words.
The death of a language takes with it not merely its vocabulary but a distinctive way of seeing the world.
Languages disappear because their words are no longer useful.
A vanished language can always be fully recovered from its words.
restate.tr: 'not only words ... but also a unique way of understanding' = sadece sözcükler değil, dünyayı anlamanın özgün bir biçimi; doğru cevap bu eklemeyi korur. Çeldirici 'sadece sözcük' diyerek eksiltir.
restate.en: 'not only words ... but also a unique way of understanding' keeps the addition; a distractor reduces it to 'just words'.

restate.stem: Using bright screens late at night can make it harder to fall asleep, because the light interferes with the body's natural rhythms.
opts: Bright screens at night help people fall asleep more quickly.
The body's rhythms have nothing to do with screen light.
Looking at bright screens late at night may delay sleep, since the light disrupts the body's natural rhythms.
People sleep better the more they use screens before bed.
restate.tr: 'make it harder to fall asleep, because the light interferes' = ışık ritmi bozduğu için uykuyu zorlaştırır; doğru cevap neden-sonucu korur. Çeldiriciler tersini (uykuyu kolaylaştırır) iddia eder.
restate.en: 'make it harder to fall asleep, because the light interferes' keeps the cause-effect; distractors claim the opposite.

restate.stem: The fossil record is incomplete, so the absence of a species from a particular layer does not necessarily mean it was extinct at that time.
opts: If a species is missing from a layer, it was certainly extinct then.
The fossil record is complete, so missing species must have been extinct.
Fossils can never tell us anything about when species lived.
Because the fossil record has gaps, a species' absence from a layer does not prove it had died out by then.
restate.tr: 'incomplete, so absence does not necessarily mean extinct' = kayıt eksik olduğundan yokluk mutlaka soy tükenmesi değil; doğru cevap bu temkinli çıkarımı korur. Çeldiriciler yanlış kesinlik ekler.
restate.en: 'incomplete, so absence does not necessarily mean extinct' keeps the cautious inference; distractors add false certainty.

restate.stem: The proposed reform would simplify the tax system, though critics worry that it could reduce the revenue available for public services.
opts: While the reform would make the tax system simpler, opponents fear it might cut the funds available for public services.
The reform would complicate the tax system and increase public revenue.
Everyone agrees the reform would raise more money for public services.
Critics believe the reform would have no effect on public services at all.
restate.tr: 'would simplify ... though critics worry it could reduce revenue' = sadeleştirir ama eleştirmenler geliri azaltabileceğinden kaygılı; doğru cevap iki yönü de korur. Çeldiriciler sadeleştirmeyi ya da kaygıyı tersine çevirir.
restate.en: 'would simplify ... though critics worry it could reduce revenue' keeps both; distractors reverse the simplification or the concern.

restate.stem: Robotic systems can assist surgeons by improving precision, but they are tools that still depend entirely on human judgement.
opts: Robotic systems have replaced surgeons and now operate on their own.
Although robotic systems can make surgery more precise, they remain instruments that rely completely on human decision-making.
Robots make surgery less precise and should not be used.
Human judgement plays no part once a robotic system is used.
restate.tr: 'can assist ... but still depend entirely on human judgement' = yardımcı olur ama tamamen insan kararına bağlı; doğru cevap bu dengeyi korur. Çeldiriciler insan rolünü siler ya da robotu işe yaramaz sayar.
restate.en: 'can assist ... but still depend entirely on human judgement' keeps the balance; distractors erase the human role or dismiss the robots.

restate.stem: Much of the plastic that ends up in the ocean breaks into tiny pieces that are almost impossible to remove.
opts: Plastic in the ocean stays in large pieces that are easy to collect.
The ocean naturally dissolves all the plastic that reaches it.
A large part of ocean plastic fragments into minuscule particles that can scarcely be cleared away.
Removing plastic from the ocean is a simple and quick task.
restate.tr: 'breaks into tiny pieces almost impossible to remove' = temizlemesi neredeyse imkânsız küçük parçalara ayrılır; doğru cevap bunu korur. Çeldiriciler zorluğu yok sayar.
restate.en: 'breaks into tiny pieces almost impossible to remove' is kept; distractors deny the difficulty.

restate.stem: Remote work offers employees greater flexibility, but it can also blur the boundary between professional and personal life.
opts: Remote work removes all flexibility from employees' schedules.
Working from home keeps work and personal life strictly separate.
Remote work has no effect on the balance between work and personal life.
While remote work gives employees more flexibility, it may also make the line between work and home life less clear.
restate.tr: 'offers flexibility, but can blur the boundary' = esneklik sağlar ama sınırı bulanıklaştırabilir; doğru cevap iki yönü de korur. Çeldiriciler esnekliği yok sayar ya da sınırın net kaldığını söyler.
restate.en: 'offers flexibility, but can blur the boundary' keeps both; distractors drop the flexibility or claim the line stays sharp.

sentences: Many early printers, however, complained that the quality of locally produced paper was disappointingly poor.
The invention of the printing press in the fifteenth century made it possible to produce books far more quickly than by hand.
As a result, texts that had once been rare and expensive gradually became affordable to a much wider public.
This rapid spread of printed material helped ideas to circulate across borders with unprecedented speed.
Within a few generations, literacy rates began to rise in regions where printing had taken hold.
oddout.tr: Paragraf matbaanın fikirleri yayması ve okuryazarlığı artırmasını anlatır; kâğıt kalitesinden şikâyet eden cümle yan bir ayrıntı olup anlam bütünlüğünü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about printing spreading ideas and literacy; the sentence complaining about poor paper quality is a side detail that breaks the unity.

sentences: Plants use sunlight to turn water and carbon dioxide into the sugars they need to grow.
Some gardeners prefer to plant their vegetables in neat, straight rows.
This process, called photosynthesis, takes place mainly in the green parts of the plant.
In doing so, plants release oxygen, which most living things depend on to breathe.
Without photosynthesis, life as we know it on Earth could not exist.
oddout.tr: Paragraf fotosentezi ve önemini açıklar; bahçıvanların düzgün sıralar tercih etmesini anlatan cümle konuyla ilgisizdir.
oddout.en: The paragraph explains photosynthesis and its importance; the sentence about gardeners preferring neat rows is irrelevant.

sentences: Many teenagers find it difficult to fall asleep early, partly because of natural changes in their body clock.
Yet most schools still begin classes at a time that suits younger children far better.
Football remains one of the most popular sports among students of this age.
As a result, a large number of adolescents arrive at school without having had enough sleep.
Researchers say this lack of rest can affect both their mood and their ability to concentrate.
oddout.tr: Paragraf ergenlerde uyku eksikliği ve sonuçlarını ele alır; futbolun popülerliğinden söz eden cümle bağlam dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about teenage sleep deprivation and its effects; the sentence about football's popularity is off-topic.

sentences: The Romans built an extensive network of roads to move their armies quickly across the empire.
These roads were carefully engineered, with solid foundations and drainage that allowed them to last for centuries.
Merchants soon took advantage of them, and trade flourished along the same routes the legions used.
Modern tourists today often prefer to travel by high-speed train rather than by car.
Long after the empire fell, many of these roads continued to shape the movement of people and goods.
oddout.tr: Paragraf Roma yollarının askeri ve ticari önemini anlatır; modern turistlerin tren tercihini anlatan cümle bütünlüğü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph concerns Roman roads' military and commercial role; the sentence about modern tourists' train preference breaks the unity.

sentences: Bees play a vital role in agriculture by pollinating a large share of the crops we eat.
In recent years, however, beekeepers in many countries have reported alarming losses in their colonies.
Scientists suspect that a combination of pesticides, disease, and habitat loss is to blame.
If these trends continue, the cost of producing many fruits and vegetables could rise sharply.
Honey has been used as a natural sweetener since ancient times.
oddout.tr: Paragraf arı kayıplarının tarımsal sonuçlarını ele alır; balın eski çağlardan beri tatlandırıcı olduğunu söyleyen cümle konuyla bağlantısızdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about bee losses and their effect on agriculture; the sentence about honey as an ancient sweetener is unrelated.

sentences: Jazz music developed a number of distinctive regional styles during this period.
The economic collapse of the 1930s threw millions of people out of work across the industrialised world.
Banks failed, factories closed, and families that had once been comfortable suddenly faced hardship.
Governments responded with large public works programmes intended to put people back to work.
These measures marked a lasting change in how states viewed their responsibility for the economy.
oddout.tr: Paragraf Büyük Buhran ve devlet müdahalesini anlatır; caz müziğinin bölgesel stillerinden söz eden cümle bütünlüğü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about the Depression and state intervention; the sentence about regional jazz styles breaks the unity.

sentences: A successful vaccination programme depends on reaching a very high proportion of the population.
The first hospitals in the region were built largely from local stone.
When enough people are protected, even those who cannot be vaccinated benefit from reduced spread.
For this reason, health workers often travel to remote villages to make sure no one is missed.
Keeping vaccines at the right temperature during transport is another major challenge.
oddout.tr: Paragraf aşı programlarının kapsama ve lojistik zorluklarını anlatır; hastanelerin taştan yapıldığını söyleyen cümle konu dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph concerns vaccination coverage and logistics; the sentence about hospitals built from stone is off-topic.

sentences: Glaciers act as natural reservoirs, storing water as ice in winter and releasing it slowly in summer.
Millions of people downstream rely on this steady flow for drinking water and irrigation.
Mountaineering became a fashionable pastime among the European middle classes in the nineteenth century.
As the climate warms, however, many glaciers are shrinking faster than they can be replenished.
In the short term this produces more meltwater, but in the long term the supply may sharply decline.
oddout.tr: Paragraf buzulların su kaynağı işlevini ve erimesini anlatır; dağcılığın moda olmasından söz eden cümle bağlam dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about glaciers as water sources and their melting; the sentence about mountaineering as fashion is off-topic.

sentences: The earliest writing systems seem to have developed not for literature but for keeping records.
Merchants and officials needed a reliable way to track goods, debts, and payments.
Over time, these practical signs grew into scripts capable of expressing complex ideas.
Clay is a soft material that hardens when it is heated in a fire.
Eventually, the same systems were used to record laws, prayers, and stories.
oddout.tr: Paragraf yazının kayıt tutmadan edebiyata gelişimini anlatır; kilin ısıtılınca sertleştiğini söyleyen genel bilgi cümlesi bütünlüğü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph traces writing from record-keeping to literature; the generic sentence about clay hardening when heated breaks the unity.

sentences: People tend to assume that memory works like a recording that can be played back exactly.
In reality, every act of remembering involves reconstructing the past rather than replaying it.
Because of this, witnesses can sincerely report details that never actually happened.
Researchers have shown that even simple leading questions can reshape what a person recalls.
Many courtrooms are decorated with wood panelling and high ceilings.
oddout.tr: Paragraf belleğin yeniden inşa edici doğasını ve tanık güvenilirliğini anlatır; mahkeme salonlarının dekorundan söz eden cümle konuyla ilgisizdir.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about reconstructive memory and witness reliability; the sentence about courtroom decor is unrelated.

sentences: The first long-distance telephone call was a remarkable technical achievement.
Solar panels convert sunlight directly into electricity without any moving parts.
Because of this, they are quiet, clean, and relatively cheap to maintain.
Their output falls on cloudy days, so they are often paired with batteries or other sources.
As prices have dropped, panels have appeared on the roofs of homes all over the world.
oddout.tr: Paragraf güneş panellerinin işleyişi ve yayılmasını anlatır; ilk şehirlerarası telefon görüşmesinden söz eden cümle konu dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about how solar panels work and spread; the sentence about the first long-distance telephone call is off-topic.

sentences: Modern archaeologists rely on far more than the spade to understand the past.
Most museums close to visitors at least one day a week for cleaning.
Techniques such as ground-penetrating radar can reveal buried structures without any digging.
Chemical analysis of pottery can show what foods were once stored or cooked in it.
Even tiny grains of pollen can tell researchers which plants grew nearby thousands of years ago.
oddout.tr: Paragraf modern arkeolojik yöntemleri sıralar; müzelerin temizlik için kapandığını söyleyen cümle bütünlüğü bozar.
oddout.en: The paragraph lists modern archaeological methods; the sentence about museum closing days breaks the unity.

sentences: Rates of obesity have risen sharply in many countries over the past few decades.
Experts point to diets high in sugar and fat, combined with increasingly inactive lifestyles.
The recipe calls for two eggs, a cup of flour, and a pinch of salt.
Cheap, energy-dense food is now available almost everywhere and at any hour.
Meanwhile, many jobs that once involved physical effort are now done sitting at a desk.
oddout.tr: Paragraf obezite artışının nedenlerini açıklar; bir yemek tarifi veren cümle konuyla bağlantısızdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph explains the causes of rising obesity; the sentence giving a recipe is unrelated.

sentences: Some of the earliest civilisations grew up along the banks of great rivers.
The yearly floods left behind fertile soil that made reliable farming possible.
Surplus food allowed some people to specialise in crafts, trade, or administration.
Sailing boats are usually faster than rowing boats when the wind is strong.
From these settlements eventually emerged cities, writing, and organised states.
oddout.tr: Paragraf nehir kenarındaki erken uygarlıkların doğuşunu anlatır; yelkenli teknelerin hızından söz eden cümle konu dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about early river civilisations; the sentence about sailing boats' speed is off-topic.

sentences: Machine translation has improved enormously thanks to systems trained on vast amounts of text.
These tools can now produce fluent drafts that would have seemed impossible a generation ago.
Yet they still struggle with humour, cultural references, and deliberate ambiguity.
For this reason, professional translators remain essential for sensitive or creative work.
The oldest surviving libraries were often attached to temples or palaces.
oddout.tr: Paragraf makine çevirisinin gelişimi ve sınırlarını anlatır; en eski kütüphanelerden söz eden cümle konu dışıdır.
oddout.en: The paragraph is about the progress and limits of machine translation; the sentence about the oldest libraries is off-topic.

lines.t: Our proposal was technically excellent, yet the committee still rejected it.
You may be right. Perhaps we failed to show how the findings would benefit the wider public.

opts: Maybe the problem wasn't the quality of the work but how well we explained its relevance.
I suppose the science simply wasn't strong enough, then.
Then we should submit exactly the same proposal again next year.
It clearly means they never read the proposal at all.
dialogue.tr: A teknik mükemmellik olmasına rağmen reddi vurguluyor; sonrasında 'kamu yararını gösterememek'i kabul ediyor. B, kaliteyi değil anlatımı sorgulayarak bu akışa uyar.
dialogue.en: A stresses rejection despite technical excellence and then concedes they failed to show public relevance. B fits by questioning the framing, not the quality.

lines.t: Did you manage to see the new exhibition at the history museum?
I did, but honestly the labels were so long that I gave up reading them.
Exactly. A few clear sentences would have told me far more than those huge paragraphs.

opts: I agree the rooms were far too dark to see anything.
I know what you mean; sometimes too much information is worse than too little.
That's a shame, because the entrance fee was quite cheap.
So you think the museum should add even more detail to the labels?
dialogue.tr: B etiketlerin fazla uzun olmasından yakınır; sonraki replikte 'birkaç net cümle daha iyi olurdu' der. C, fazla bilginin azdan kötü olabileceğini söyleyerek köprü kurar.
dialogue.en: B complains the labels were too long and then says a few clear sentences would help more. C bridges this by noting too much information can be worse than too little.

lines.t: The trial showed improvement, but only in a very small number of patients.
That's exactly my concern. With so few cases, we can't rule out that it happened by chance.

opts: Then we can confidently recommend the treatment to everyone.
That proves the drug works better than any other on the market.
So the sample may simply be too small to draw any firm conclusion.
It means the patients must have been misdiagnosed from the start.
dialogue.tr: A çok az hastada iyileşmeyi belirtir; sonra 'şans eseri olabilir' kaygısını onaylar. B, örneklemin kesin sonuç için fazla küçük olduğunu söyleyerek uyumludur.
dialogue.en: A notes improvement in very few patients and then confirms a worry about chance. B fits by saying the sample may be too small for a firm conclusion.

lines.t: I always rinse the jars before putting them in the recycling bin.
Really? I had no idea that a little leftover food could ruin a whole batch.

opts: That's pointless; nobody checks whether the containers are clean.
You should stop recycling altogether to save time.
Glass jars can never be recycled, whatever you do with them.
It's a good habit, actually — dirty containers can contaminate everything else in the load.
dialogue.tr: A kavanozları yıkadığını söyler; sonra 'az artığın tüm partiyi bozabileceğini bilmediğini' belirtir. B bu bilgiyi vererek mantıklı köprü kurar.
dialogue.en: A says they rinse jars; A then admits surprise that leftover food could ruin a batch. B supplies that very information, making it the logical bridge.

lines.t: They said I was overqualified for the position. I'm not sure how to take that.
I hadn't thought of it that way. Maybe they assumed I'd leave as soon as something better came along.

opts: Sometimes employers worry that very experienced candidates will quickly become bored and move on.
It probably just means they didn't read your CV properly.
You should take it as a clear sign that you got the job.
Being overqualified always guarantees a higher salary.
dialogue.tr: A 'aşırı nitelikli' denmesine şaşırır; sonra 'daha iyisi çıkınca ayrılacağımı düşündüler' diye yorumlar. B tam bu kaygıyı dile getirerek akışı tamamlar.
dialogue.en: A is puzzled at being called overqualified and then reasons the employer feared they'd leave. B voices exactly that concern, completing the flow.

lines.t: Our teacher says we shouldn't trust a single source when studying the past.
Why not? If someone wrote it down at the time, surely it must be accurate.
I see — so even an eyewitness might describe events in a way that suits their own side.

opts: Yes, written records are always completely neutral.
Not necessarily; the person writing usually had their own interests and point of view.
That's true, which is why one source is always enough.
Then we should ignore written records entirely.
dialogue.tr: B 'aynı dönemde yazıldıysa doğrudur' der; sonra 'tanık bile kendi tarafına göre anlatabilir' diye anlar. A, yazanın kendi çıkarı olduğunu söyleyerek bu kavrayışı hazırlar.
dialogue.en: B claims a contemporary record must be accurate, then realises even a witness may be biased. A's reply about the writer's own interests sets up that realisation.

lines.t: Users keep complaining that the app is confusing, even though we added lots of new features.
You might be onto something. Maybe we should remove a few options rather than keep adding them.

opts: Then we clearly need to add even more features as quickly as possible.
It must mean the users simply aren't intelligent enough.
Perhaps all those extra features are precisely what's making it harder to use.
The app is obviously perfect, so the complaints can be ignored.
dialogue.tr: A özellik eklemeye rağmen kafa karışıklığından yakınır; sonra 'seçenek çıkaralım' der. B fazla özelliğin sorunun kaynağı olabileceğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A complains of confusion despite added features, then suggests removing options. B fits by proposing the extra features themselves cause the difficulty.

lines.t: I've cut out every kind of fat from my diet to lose weight.
Oh, I didn't realise that. So some fats are actually good for me?

opts: That's wise; the body has absolutely no use for fat of any kind.
Good idea; you should also stop drinking water for a while.
There's no point; diet has nothing to do with weight.
Be careful, though — the body actually needs some fats to work properly.
dialogue.tr: A tüm yağları kestiğini söyler; sonra 'bazı yağlar iyi mi?' diye sorar. B, vücudun bazı yağlara ihtiyaç duyduğunu söyleyerek bu soruyu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A says they cut out all fat, then asks whether some fats are good. B sets that up by noting the body needs some fats.

lines.t: The headlines say unemployment is falling, so the economy must be doing well.
That's a fair point. If people have simply stopped looking for work, the figure could be misleading.

opts: Not so fast — the rate can also fall when discouraged people give up searching altogether.
Absolutely, a falling rate always tells the whole story.
It means wages must be rising for everyone right now.
Unemployment figures have no connection to the economy.
dialogue.tr: A düşen işsizliği iyi ekonomiye bağlar; sonra 'iş aramayı bırakanlar rakamı yanıltabilir' der. B tam bu nüansı sunarak akışı tamamlar.
dialogue.en: A links falling unemployment to a strong economy, then concedes discouraged workers can distort it. B introduces exactly that nuance.

lines.t: We found no gold or jewellery at the site, so the dig was basically a failure.
When you put it like that, those broken pots and seeds probably tell us more about daily life than treasure would.

opts: I agree completely; without valuables, there's nothing worth studying.
I wouldn't say that — everyday objects often reveal far more about how people actually lived.
Then we should stop excavating the area immediately.
Gold is the only thing that ever matters in archaeology.
dialogue.tr: A değerli eşya bulunmadığı için kazıyı başarısız sayar; sonra 'kırık çömlek ve tohumlar günlük yaşamı daha iyi anlatır' der. B gündelik nesnelerin değerini vurgulayarak bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A calls the dig a failure for lack of valuables, then admits everyday finds reveal daily life better. B fits by stressing the value of ordinary objects.

lines.t: I signed up for three online courses this month, but I haven't finished a single one.
You're probably right. Maybe I should focus on just one course at a time.

opts: Then you should sign up for several more straight away.
It clearly means online courses are a complete waste of time.
Perhaps you've simply taken on too many at once to give any of them proper attention.
You must be the only person who has ever struggled with this.
dialogue.tr: A üç kursa yazılıp hiçbirini bitiremediğini söyler; sonra 'birine odaklanmalıyım' der. B aynı anda çok fazlasını üstlenmeyi işaret ederek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A enrolled in three courses and finished none, then decides to focus on one. B sets this up by suggesting they took on too many at once.

lines.t: The patient insists the new tablets aren't working, even though the tests look fine.
Good thinking. I'll ask whether she's been taking them exactly as prescribed before we change anything.

opts: Then we should obviously double the dose right away.
The tests must be wrong, so we can ignore them.
She clearly needs a completely different diagnosis.
Before adjusting the medication, it might be worth checking how regularly she's actually taking it.
dialogue.tr: A testler iyi olsa da hastanın ilacın işe yaramadığını söylediğini belirtir; sonra 'reçeteye uyup uymadığını soracağım' der. B önce uyumu kontrol etmeyi önererek bunu hazırlar.
dialogue.en: A notes the patient says the tablets fail though tests are fine, then decides to check adherence. B fits by proposing to check how regularly she takes them first.

paracomp.text: The eruption that buried Pompeii in AD 79 was a catastrophe for its inhabitants, yet it proved invaluable to later historians. ---- As a result, archaeologists have been able to study not only grand public buildings but also the ordinary details of daily life, from loaves of bread to election notices painted on the walls.
opts: The volcanic ash sealed the town so suddenly that it preserved an entire community almost exactly as it had been.
Most other ancient cities were gradually rebuilt and altered over many centuries.
Modern tourists now arrive at the site in their thousands every single day.
Few written accounts of the disaster have survived into the present.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra korunmuşluğun sonuçları (ekmek, duvar yazıları) gelir; doğru cevap külün kasabayı aniden mühürleyip koruduğunu söyleyerek bu sonucu hazırlar. Diğer seçenekler kül/koruma izleğini sürdürmez.
paracomp.en: After the gap come the results of preservation (bread, wall notices); the correct option explains the ash suddenly sealed the town, setting up that result. The others fail to continue the ash/preservation thread.

paracomp.text: The deep ocean was long imagined to be a lifeless desert, too dark and cold for anything to survive. ---- Strange communities of creatures cluster around volcanic vents on the sea floor, drawing energy not from sunlight but from chemicals rising out of the Earth itself.
opts: Sunlight easily reaches even the deepest parts of the sea.
Recent expeditions, however, have revealed that life flourishes even in these extreme depths.
As a result, no one has ever attempted to explore the ocean floor.
Most fish prefer to live close to warm tropical beaches.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra volkanik bacalardaki canlı örneği gelir; doğru cevap 'however' ile eski 'cansız çöl' görüşünü çürütüp derinlerde yaşamın geliştiğini söyleyerek örneği hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes the example of life around vents; the correct option uses 'however' to overturn the 'lifeless desert' view and introduce thriving deep-sea life.

paracomp.text: When a doctor first suggested that washing hands could prevent the spread of disease, his colleagues largely dismissed the idea. ---- Today, however, hand hygiene is recognised as one of the simplest and most effective ways to stop infections in hospitals.
opts: They immediately adopted his method in every ward of the hospital.
He had also invented several new surgical instruments.
At the time, no one understood that invisible germs could pass from one patient to another.
Most patients in those days recovered very quickly.
paracomp.tr: Boşluk, fikrin reddi ile bugünkü kabulü arasında köprüdür; doğru cevap o dönemde görünmez mikropların bilinmediğini söyleyerek reddi açıklar.
paracomp.en: The gap bridges rejection and today's acceptance; the correct option explains the rejection by noting invisible germs were then unknown.

paracomp.text: Before the invention of money, people exchanged goods directly through barter, swapping grain for tools or cloth for livestock. ---- A coin, by contrast, could be accepted by anyone and stored until it was needed, which is why money gradually replaced barter in almost every society.
opts: This system worked smoothly as long as both parties were satisfied.
Livestock were considered the most valuable of all possessions.
Many ancient coins were beautifully decorated with portraits of rulers.
The trouble was that barter only worked when each person happened to want exactly what the other offered.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'oysa parayı herkes kabul eder' karşıtlığı gelir; doğru cevap takasın yalnızca karşılıklı istek varsa işlediğini söyleyerek paranın üstünlüğünü hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap comes the contrast that a coin is accepted by anyone; the correct option sets it up by noting barter needs a double coincidence of wants.

paracomp.text: Antarctica holds about seventy per cent of the world's fresh water, locked away in a vast sheet of ice. ---- For this reason, scientists monitor the continent closely, since even a partial loss of this ice could raise sea levels enough to threaten coastal cities around the globe.
opts: If even a fraction of that ice were to melt, the effect on the oceans would be enormous.
The continent is also home to a wide variety of tropical plants.
Very few researchers have ever shown any interest in the region.
Antarctica receives more rainfall than almost anywhere else on Earth.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu yüzden izleniyor; deniz seviyeleri yükselebilir' gelir; doğru cevap buzun bir kısmının erimesinin etkisinin büyük olacağını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: scientists monitor it because melting could raise sea levels; the correct option notes that even partial melting would have an enormous effect.

paracomp.text: People often blame a lack of willpower when they fail to change their behaviour. ---- Researchers suggest that designing one's surroundings carefully — keeping healthy food visible or leaving running shoes by the door — can make good habits far easier to maintain than sheer determination alone.
opts: Willpower is in fact unlimited and never runs out during the day.
Yet studies increasingly show that environment shapes our actions at least as much as personal resolve.
Most people find it very easy to break long-established routines.
Changing a habit has nothing to do with one's daily surroundings.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra çevreyi düzenlemenin iradeden etkili olduğu örneği gelir; doğru cevap çevrenin davranışı en az irade kadar biçimlendirdiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar. Çevreyle ilgisiz diyen seçenek örnekle çelişir.
paracomp.en: After the gap, arranging one's environment beats willpower; the correct option notes environment shapes behaviour as much as resolve. The option denying any role of surroundings contradicts the example.

paracomp.text: Each year a tree adds a new ring of growth to its trunk, and these rings can be read almost like a diary. ---- A wide ring points to a warm, wet season with plenty of growth, while a narrow one suggests a year of drought or cold.
opts: Trees of the same species always grow at exactly the same speed.
Most trees lose all their rings during the winter months.
The width of each ring records what the weather was like in that particular year.
Counting rings is the only thing scientists can learn from old wood.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'geniş halka sıcak/yağışlı, dar halka kuraklık' gelir; doğru cevap halka genişliğinin o yılki havayı kaydettiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: wide ring = warm/wet, narrow = drought; the correct option states ring width records that year's weather.

paracomp.text: The rise of digital platforms has created millions of short-term, flexible jobs in what is often called the gig economy. ---- Critics, however, point out that this freedom frequently comes without the security of a steady wage, paid holidays, or protection against sudden loss of work.
opts: Traditional factories have completely disappeared as a result.
These platforms refuse to let anyone work flexible hours.
Most gig workers are guaranteed a generous pension.
Such jobs are valued by some workers for the freedom to choose their own hours.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'eleştirmenler bu özgürlüğün güvencesiz geldiğini söyler' (however) gelir; doğru cevap bazı işçilerin esnekliği özgürlük için değerli bulduğunu söyleyerek karşıtlığı hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap, critics say this freedom lacks security ('however'); the correct option sets up the contrast by noting some workers value the freedom of flexible hours.

paracomp.text: After the body fights off a particular infection, it does not simply return to its previous state. ---- Thanks to these long-lived defenders, a second encounter with the same germ is often dealt with so quickly that the person never even feels ill.
opts: Instead, it keeps a population of specialised cells that remember the invader.
The immune system forgets every infection within a few hours.
Most infections leave the body permanently weakened.
The body reacts to every germ in exactly the same way.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu uzun ömürlü savunucular sayesinde ikinci karşılaşma hızlı atlatılır' gelir; doğru cevap bağışıklığın istilacıyı hatırlayan hücreler tuttuğunu söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: thanks to long-lived defenders a second encounter is handled fast; the correct option notes the system keeps memory cells of the invader.

paracomp.text: For decades the location of the ancient city was known only from a few lines in old texts. ---- Using satellite images and ground surveys, a team finally identified faint patterns in the soil that matched the descriptions, and excavation soon confirmed that the long-lost settlement had been found.
opts: The city had in fact never existed outside of legend.
Recent advances in technology, however, gave researchers new tools to search for it.
Nobody had ever bothered to read those old texts.
The texts gave precise modern coordinates for the site.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'uydu görüntüleri ve yüzey araştırması ile bulundu' gelir; doğru cevap yeni teknolojinin arama araçları sağladığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: satellites and surveys located it; the correct option notes new technology gave researchers fresh tools to search.

paracomp.text: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes, which makes them attractive in crowded cities suffering from poor air quality. ---- If that power is generated by burning coal, the overall benefit to the climate is far smaller than it might at first appear.
opts: Their batteries never need to be charged at all.
Electric cars are always more expensive than petrol ones.
Yet the electricity they run on still has to be produced somewhere.
Air quality in cities has nothing to do with traffic.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'o güç kömürle üretilirse iklim faydası küçülür' gelir; doğru cevap kullanılan elektriğin bir yerde üretilmesi gerektiğini söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: if that power comes from coal the climate benefit shrinks; the correct option notes the electricity must still be produced somewhere.

paracomp.text: It might seem obvious that the more people who witness an emergency, the more likely someone is to help. ---- Psychologists have found the opposite can occur: when many onlookers are present, each individual tends to assume that somebody else will take responsibility, and so no one acts at all.
opts: In practice, a large crowd always guarantees a swift rescue.
Emergencies are extremely rare in crowded public places.
People in groups are far braver than people on their own.
Surprisingly, a larger group of witnesses does not necessarily mean faster assistance.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'psikologlar tersinin olabileceğini bulmuş: herkes başkası yapar sanır' gelir; doğru cevap kalabalık tanığın daha hızlı yardım demek olmadığını söyleyerek bunu hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap, psychologists find the opposite (diffusion of responsibility); the correct option notes more witnesses don't necessarily mean faster help.

paracomp.text: In the medieval period, spices such as pepper and cinnamon were worth almost their weight in gold. ---- This extraordinary value drove merchants to undertake long and dangerous journeys, and it eventually encouraged European powers to seek direct sea routes to the lands where the spices grew.
opts: Because they could only be grown in distant regions, supplies in Europe were scarce and unpredictable.
They were so common that nobody paid much attention to them.
Most cooks of the time avoided using any spices at all.
Gold, by comparison, was almost impossible to find.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'bu olağanüstü değer tüccarları uzun yolculuklara itti' gelir; doğru cevap baharatın yalnızca uzak bölgelerde yetiştiği için kıt olduğunu söyleyerek değeri açıklar.
paracomp.en: After the gap: this extraordinary value drove long voyages; the correct option explains the value by noting spices grew only in distant regions, so supply was scarce.

paracomp.text: The human gut is home to trillions of bacteria, and for a long time these were regarded mainly as a threat to be eliminated. ---- It is now clear that many of them help us digest food, produce essential vitamins, and even influence our mood, so that destroying them all would do far more harm than good.
opts: Bacteria of every kind are equally dangerous to human health.
Modern research, however, has revealed how useful these microbes can be.
The gut contains almost no bacteria in a healthy adult.
Scientists still know nothing whatever about gut bacteria.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra sindirim, vitamin, ruh hali yararları gelir; doğru cevap 'however' ile eski 'tehdit' görüşünü çürütüp araştırmanın mikropların yararını ortaya koyduğunu söyler.
paracomp.en: After the gap come benefits (digestion, vitamins, mood); the correct option uses 'however' to overturn the old 'threat' view by noting research revealed the microbes' usefulness.

paracomp.text: Each year millions of visitors travel to sites associated with disaster, war, or tragedy. ---- Supporters argue that such visits help keep painful memories alive and teach valuable lessons, while critics worry that they can turn human suffering into mere entertainment.
opts: Nobody has ever questioned the purpose of visiting these places.
These sites are usually completely empty throughout the year.
This practice has sparked a lively debate about whether it is respectful or not.
Tourism of this kind brings no money to the local area.
paracomp.tr: Boşluktan sonra 'destekçiler ... eleştirenler ...' tartışması gelir; doğru cevap bu uygulamanın saygılı olup olmadığına dair canlı bir tartışma başlattığını söyleyerek iki görüşü hazırlar.
paracomp.en: After the gap come supporters vs. critics; the correct option sets up both sides by noting the practice sparked a lively debate over whether it is respectful.

translate.source: The evidence suggests that human activity has played a decisive role in the recent rise in global temperatures.
opts: Kanıtlar, insan faaliyetinin son zamanlardaki küresel sıcaklık artışında belirleyici bir rol oynadığını göstermektedir.
Kanıtlara göre küresel sıcaklıklar insan faaliyetinden bağımsız olarak yükselmiştir.
İnsan faaliyetinin küresel ısınmayı durdurmada önemli bir rol oynadığı ileri sürülmektedir.
Bazı kanıtlar, sıcaklık artışının yakında duracağını ima etmektedir.
translate.tr: 'has played a decisive role in the recent rise' = son artışta belirleyici rol oynadı; doğru çeviri bunu birebir karşılar. Çeldiriciler 'bağımsız' ya da 'durdurma' diyerek anlamı çarpıtır.
translate.en: 'has played a decisive role in the recent rise' is rendered exactly by the correct translation; distractors distort it with 'independent' or 'stopping'.

translate.source: Scholars have long debated whether the manuscript was written by a single author or compiled from several earlier sources.
opts: Akademisyenler el yazmasının kim tarafından yazıldığını hiçbir zaman merak etmemiştir.
Akademisyenler el yazmasının tek bir yazar tarafından mı yazıldığını yoksa daha eski birkaç kaynaktan mı derlendiğini uzun süredir tartışmaktadır.
El yazmasının tek bir yazara ait olduğu artık kesin olarak bilinmektedir.
Akademisyenler yakın zamanda el yazmasının sahte olduğunu kanıtlamıştır.
translate.tr: 'have long debated whether ... or ...' = uzun süredir ... mı yoksa ... mı diye tartışıyor; doğru çeviri iki seçenekli tartışmayı korur. Çeldiriciler kesinlik ekler ya da konuyu değiştirir.
translate.en: 'have long debated whether ... or ...' keeps the two-option debate in the correct translation; distractors add false certainty or change the topic.

translate.source: Although the treatment appears promising, doctors warn that it should not be used widely until further trials confirm its safety.
opts: Tedavi umut verici göründüğü için doktorlar onun hemen yaygın olarak kullanılmasını önermektedir.
Doktorlar tedavinin güvenli olmadığını ve asla kullanılmaması gerektiğini söylemektedir.
Tedavi umut verici görünse de doktorlar, güvenliği başka denemelerle doğrulanana dek yaygın biçimde kullanılmaması gerektiği konusunda uyarmaktadır.
Tedavinin güvenliği zaten kanıtlandığından başka denemeye gerek yoktur.
translate.tr: 'Although ... promising ... should not be used widely until further trials confirm' = umut verici olsa da denemeler doğrulayana dek yaygın kullanılmamalı; doğru çeviri bu koşullu uyarıyı korur. Çeldiriciler çekinceyi siler.
translate.en: 'Although promising ... should not be used widely until further trials confirm' keeps the conditional caution; distractors drop the caveat.

translate.source: The government's decision to raise interest rates was intended to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing economic growth.
opts: Hükûmet, ekonomik büyümeyi hızlandırmak için faiz oranlarını düşürmeye karar vermiştir.
Faiz oranlarındaki artış enflasyonu yükseltmek amacıyla yapılmıştır.
Hükûmet, büyümeyi yavaşlatmamak için faiz oranlarını sabit tutmaya karar verdi.
Hükûmetin faiz oranlarını artırma kararı, ekonomik büyümeyi yavaşlatma riskini göze alarak bile enflasyonu dizginlemeyi amaçlıyordu.
translate.tr: 'to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing growth' = büyümeyi yavaşlatma riskini göze alarak enflasyonu dizginlemek; doğru çeviri bu amaç-risk dengesini korur. Çeldiriciler kararın yönünü tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'to curb inflation, even at the risk of slowing growth' keeps the aim-risk balance; distractors reverse the decision.

translate.source: The artefacts found at the site reveal that the community traded with regions far beyond its own borders.
opts: Bölgede bulunan eserler, topluluğun kendi sınırlarının çok ötesindeki bölgelerle ticaret yaptığını ortaya koymaktadır.
Bölgede hiçbir esere rastlanmadığı için ticaret yapılıp yapılmadığı bilinmemektedir.
Topluluğun yalnızca komşu köylerle ticaret yaptığı anlaşılmıştır.
Bulunan eserler topluluğun dış dünyadan tamamen yalıtılmış olduğunu göstermektedir.
translate.tr: 'traded with regions far beyond its own borders' = kendi sınırlarının çok ötesindeki bölgelerle ticaret; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler 'yalnızca komşu' ya da 'yalıtılmış' diyerek çelişir.
translate.en: 'traded with regions far beyond its own borders' is kept; distractors contradict it with 'only neighbours' or 'isolated'.

translate.source: The brain remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life, forming new connections in response to learning and experience.
opts: Beyin yalnızca çocuklukta gelişir ve yetişkinlikte hiç değişmez.
Beyin, yaşam boyunca kendini yeniden düzenleyebilme yeteneğini korur ve öğrenme ile deneyime karşılık yeni bağlantılar kurar.
Beyin, deneyimden bağımsız olarak doğuştan gelen bağlantılarını korur.
Öğrenme, beynin yeni bağlantılar kurmasını engeller.
translate.tr: 'remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life ... new connections' = yaşam boyu kendini düzenleyip yeni bağlantı kurar; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler yetişkinlikte değişmez der ya da öğrenmenin engellediğini söyler.
translate.en: 'remains capable of reorganising itself throughout life ... new connections' is kept; distractors say it never changes in adulthood or that learning prevents new connections.

translate.source: As the cost of clean energy continues to fall, more and more households are choosing to install solar panels on their roofs.
opts: Temiz enerji pahalı kaldığı için çok az hane güneş paneli kurmaktadır.
Güneş panellerinin maliyeti arttıkça haneler bunlardan vazgeçmektedir.
Temiz enerjinin maliyeti düşmeye devam ettikçe gittikçe daha fazla hane, çatılarına güneş paneli kurmayı tercih ediyor.
Haneler, çatılarındaki güneş panellerini sökmeye karar vermiştir.
translate.tr: 'As the cost ... continues to fall, more and more households are choosing to install' = maliyet düştükçe daha çok hane kurmayı tercih ediyor; doğru çeviri bu neden-sonucu korur. Çeldiriciler yönü tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'As the cost continues to fall, more households are choosing to install' keeps the cause-effect; distractors reverse it.

translate.source: Planners increasingly recognise that a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people who live in it.
opts: Şehir plancıları, otomobiller için tasarlanan şehirlerin insanlar için de en uygun şehirler olduğunu savunuyor.
Plancılar, şehirlerin yalnızca otomobiller düşünülerek tasarlanması gerektiğini söylüyor.
İnsanlar için tasarlanan şehirlerin otomobillere hiç yer bırakmadığı kabul edilmektedir.
Şehir plancıları, otomobiller etrafında tasarlanmış bir şehrin, orada yaşayan insanlar için tasarlanmış bir şehir olmadığını giderek daha çok kabul ediyor.
translate.tr: 'a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people' = otomobiller için tasarlanan şehir nadiren insanlar içindir; doğru çeviri bu karşıtlığı korur. Çeldiriciler anlamı tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'a city designed around cars is rarely a city designed for the people' keeps the contrast; distractors reverse the meaning.

translate.source: Tarihçiler, imparatorluğun çöküşünün tek bir nedene değil, birbiriyle ilişkili birçok etkenin birleşimine bağlanması gerektiğini savunmaktadır.
opts: Historians argue that the empire's collapse should be attributed not to a single cause but to a combination of many interrelated factors.
Historians believe that the empire collapsed for one simple and obvious reason.
Historians claim that the empire never actually collapsed at all.
Historians suggest that the many factors behind the collapse were entirely unrelated to one another.
translate.tr: 'tek bir nedene değil ... birçok etkenin birleşimine' = not to a single cause but to a combination of many factors; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler tek neden ya da 'ilişkisiz etkenler' diyerek çelişir.
translate.en: 'not to a single cause but to a combination of interrelated factors' is kept; distractors give a single cause or call the factors unrelated.

translate.source: Araştırmacılar, yeni ilacın yan etkilerinin tam olarak anlaşılabilmesi için daha uzun süreli çalışmalara ihtiyaç duyulduğunu vurgulamaktadır.
opts: Researchers claim that the side effects of the new drug are already completely understood.
Researchers emphasise that longer-term studies are needed before the side effects of the new drug can be fully understood.
Researchers argue that no further studies of the new drug are necessary.
Researchers stress that the new drug has no side effects whatsoever.
translate.tr: 'tam olarak anlaşılabilmesi için daha uzun çalışmalara ihtiyaç' = longer-term studies are needed before fully understood; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler gereği siler ya da tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'longer-term studies are needed before the side effects can be fully understood' is kept; distractors drop or reverse the need.

translate.source: Ormanların hızla yok edilmesi, yalnızca pek çok türün yaşam alanını değil, aynı zamanda bölgenin iklimini de tehdit etmektedir.
opts: The rapid destruction of forests threatens only the habitat of a few rare species.
Planting new forests has improved both wildlife and the regional climate.
The rapid destruction of forests threatens not only the habitat of many species but also the climate of the region.
The destruction of forests has no effect on the climate of the region.
translate.tr: 'yalnızca ... değil, aynı zamanda ... de' = not only ... but also ...; doğru çeviri bu çift vurguyu korur. Çeldiriciler kapsamı daraltır ya da etkiyi inkâr eder.
translate.en: 'not only ... but also ...' keeps the double emphasis; distractors narrow the scope or deny the effect.

translate.source: Yapay zekâ araçları giderek yetkinleşse de, karmaşık etik kararların hâlâ insan denetimini gerektirdiği yaygın olarak kabul edilmektedir.
opts: Because artificial intelligence tools are now fully capable, human oversight of ethical decisions is no longer needed.
Artificial intelligence tools remain too weak to be of any use in decision-making.
It is widely denied that ethical decisions have anything to do with human judgement.
Although artificial intelligence tools are becoming increasingly capable, it is widely accepted that complex ethical decisions still require human oversight.
translate.tr: 'giderek yetkinleşse de ... insan denetimini gerektirir' = although increasingly capable ... still require human oversight; doğru çeviri bu ödün yapısını korur. Çeldiriciler denetimi gereksiz sayar.
translate.en: 'although increasingly capable ... still require human oversight' keeps the concessive structure; distractors drop the needed oversight.

translate.source: İnsanların kararlarının çoğu zaman mantıktan çok duygulardan etkilendiği, son yıllarda yapılan deneylerle açıkça gösterilmiştir.
opts: Experiments carried out in recent years have clearly shown that people's decisions are often influenced more by emotion than by logic.
Recent experiments have shown that people's decisions are guided purely by cold logic.
It has never been demonstrated that emotions affect human decisions.
People's decisions are influenced more by logic than by emotion, recent studies suggest.
translate.tr: 'mantıktan çok duygulardan etkilendiği' = influenced more by emotion than by logic; doğru çeviri bu karşılaştırmayı korur. Çeldiriciler karşılaştırmayı tersine çevirir ya da inkâr eder.
translate.en: 'influenced more by emotion than by logic' keeps the comparison; distractors reverse or deny it.

translate.source: Küçük işletmeler, büyük şirketlerle rekabet edebilmek için çoğu zaman yenilikçi fikirlere ve esnek çalışma biçimlerine güvenmek zorundadır.
opts: Large companies usually rely on small businesses to provide them with innovative ideas.
In order to compete with large companies, small businesses often have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible ways of working.
Small businesses rarely need any new ideas to compete with large companies.
Small businesses prefer to avoid competing with large companies altogether.
translate.tr: 'rekabet edebilmek için ... yenilikçi fikirlere ve esnek çalışmaya güvenmek zorunda' = to compete ... have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible working; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler gereği yok sayar.
translate.en: 'in order to compete ... have to rely on innovative ideas and flexible working' is kept; distractors remove the need.

translate.source: Kazılarda bulunan araç gereçler, bu toplumun düşünüldüğünden çok daha gelişmiş bir teknolojiye sahip olduğunu ortaya koymaktadır.
opts: The tools found during the excavations suggest that this society had almost no technology at all.
No tools were discovered during the excavations of this society.
The tools found during the excavations reveal that this society possessed a far more advanced technology than had been thought.
The society's technology turned out to be much simpler than researchers had expected.
translate.tr: 'düşünüldüğünden çok daha gelişmiş bir teknoloji' = a far more advanced technology than had been thought; doğru çeviri bunu korur. Çeldiriciler 'daha basit' ya da 'teknoloji yok' diyerek tersine çevirir.
translate.en: 'a far more advanced technology than had been thought' is kept; distractors reverse it with 'much simpler' or 'no technology'.
